title: Borel measurability of the left Dini derivative t ↦ liminf_{h→0+} h⁻¹μ({t − h < |x| < t}) (parent step 3(a)–(b))
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ be a measure on ℝ^P (Euclid P) with μ(B_r) < ∞ for every r ∈ ℝ, where B_r := ball(0, r) (empty for r ≤ 0). For t ∈ ℝ let D(t) := liminf_{h→0+} ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ({x : t − h < |x| < t}) ∈ [0, ∞]. Here |x| is the Euclidean norm and the liminf is taken along the filter 𝓝[>]0 on ℝ, in the complete lattice [0, ∞]. Then D : ℝ → [0, ∞] is Borel measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ r : ℝ, μ (ball (0 : Euclid P) r) < ∞) → Measurable (fun t : ℝ => liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ {x : Euclid P | t - h < ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ < t}) (𝓝[>] 0))
